text.p: Distefora Holding AG, formerly known as Interdiscount Holding AG, said its planned break-up was nearing completion with a sale of its Spanish finance company ID Iberica and two property investments in Canada.
It said in a statement the only other significant investments are a 60 percent stake in Austria's H. Niedermeyer Ges. mbH, Vienna.
"The board of directors is confident that this participation also can be sold before this year's annual shareholders' meeting," Distefora added.
A Distefora spokeswoman said a date for the shareholders' meeting had not yet been set.
ID Iberica has been sold to a group of investors that include the previous chief executive of ID Iberica.
As part of the deal, all ID Iberica's debts to Distefora have been foregiven and any potential obligations by Distefora to ID Iberica's creditors have been waived.

Distefora has also sold both property investments in Canada. One investment is a 90 percent stake in the Fallingbrooke shopping centre in Ottawa and the other is a 53 percent stake in a property in the centre of Toronto.
In July 1996 Interdiscount, a troubled Swiss photo and consumer electronics group, changed its name to Distefora.
